identity_policy: Existing starter-seed identities for nga, ngi, and u are upgraded in place; no duplicate lexical rows are created.

grammar_boundaries.kaba: Relative-pronoun sense remains separate from nominalizing/particle use.
grammar_boundaries.kane: Demonstrative-pronoun sense remains distinguishable from determiner/adjectival distribution.
grammar_boundaries.u: Pronoun he/it remains separate from masculine definite-article use.
grammar_boundaries.me: Masculine singular second-person register sensitivity is preserved.

bookkeeping_policy: existing_master is canonical/variant-aware across the full pilot.

standard_cross_check_policy.authority_boundary: corroborating evidence only; no automatic verification authority

milestone_boundary: After merge, all 100 fixed pilot candidates are human-verified and represented in the authoritative master. This satisfies the 100-entry review-pilot milestone only; it does not satisfy the 1,000-entry technical-alpha or stable/public-release gates.
